title: Summer and Fall Raku (Naked Raku)
source_quote: Our summer and fall dates for Naked Raku are now online! Join us to fire our raku kilns, handle the reduction chambers, and reveal your glowing, one-of-a-kind creations. Our next firing will be held on September 13.
summary: Ongoing raku firing dates in summer and fall where potters handle reduction chambers to create naked raku pieces. Firings scheduled on various dates including September 13; check website for full schedule.
evidence_sentence: District Clay's summer and fall Naked Raku sessions use raku kilns and reduction chambers.
evidence_quote: Join us to fire our raku kilns, handle the reduction chambers, and reveal your glowing, ​one-of-a-kind creations.
